get.description: Clients ignore event types they do not know, so engines may add types within a version. The engine keeps a bounded buffer of recent events: a `Last-Event-ID` that is unknown or no longer buffered resumes from the oldest buffered event. Event IDs keep increasing across dropped events and gaps are not signalled, so a client refetches what it shows on every reconnect.
